ns2:section.sectionText: This seminar is for the Mavis Future Faculty Fellows' Academy. This seminar will facilitate the training of the next generation of engineering faculty in research, teaching, and mentoring over the course of the fall 2020 and spring 2021 terms. Students enrolled will need to register for both the fall and spring term seminars. This course is restricted for the 2020-2021 Mavis Fellows. The Office of Engineering Graduate, Professional & Online programs will also by approval allow other senior Ph.D. students seeking academic positions to register. Contact Diana Gonzalez at dgonzal2@illinois.edu for more information. Space is limited. Class is restricted and students need to seek departmental approval by contacting Diana Gonzalez at dgonzal2@illinois.edu.
